items.title: Portrait of a Man
items.description_narrative: A bearded man sits in strict profile, his dark coat and white collar the only sharp notes against a soft, indistinct ground.
items.tags: portrait, profile, beard, seated, unidentified sitter, impressionism

items.title: Two Horses Facing Left
items.description_narrative: Two horses stand side by side facing left, their forms built from loose, confident lines of brown ink and wash. Bare paper shows through in places, leaving the drawing's quick, searching strokes visible around their legs and haunches.
items.tags: horses, drawing, sketch, degas, study

items.title: Woman Drying Herself (1888–1892)
items.description_narrative: A seated nude figure, seen from behind, is sketched almost entirely in faint grey pencil, one arm raised to her head where a small patch of reddish-brown hair is picked out in color. A cloth drapes loosely over her lower legs, its folds indicated with quick, searching lines on the pale paper.
items.tags: bather, drawing, degas, sketch, toilette

items.title: Young Woman in Blue
items.medium: Pastel over charcoal on buff paper
items.description_narrative: A woman in a blue jacket is seen from behind in profile, her hands clasped low, loose sketch lines and patches of bare paper left visible around her yellow skirt and a red upholstered chair. Edgar Degas drew this study around 1884.
items.tags: portrait, sketch, unfinished, degas, blue dress, study
items.credit_line: LwH3Qmd571a-Jw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: After the Bath, Woman Drying Herself (1884–1886)
items.description_narrative: Cropped close, a woman's torso twists beneath a pale cloth draped over one shoulder, soft blurred strokes of peach and blue blending flesh into fabric. Edgar Degas made this pastel between 1884 and 1886.
items.tags: degas, pastel, close crop, soft blending, bather, nude study

items.title: Woman Drying Herself
items.description_narrative: Rendered almost entirely in warm yellow chalk, a nude woman bends forward as another pair of hands gathers and dries her long, reddish hair. The scene is sketched with searching, overlapping lines, the background left as bare golden paper.
items.tags: bather, drawing, degas, toilette, hair
items.credit_line: cgGZJZP5DWJbdg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Nude Woman Seated on the Ground, Combing Her Hair
items.description_narrative: Seated on the ground with her legs stretched before her, a woman combs out a long fall of red-gold hair, both arms raised above her head. The figure is worked almost entirely in charcoal, with pastel reserved for the hair alone.
items.tags: bather, nude, hair, drawing, sketch

items.title: At the Races in the Countryside
items.description_narrative: A woman shades a swaddled infant with a small parasol as a top-hatted man drives their carriage past a grassy racecourse, a dog perched at his side. Riders and other carriages dot the flat green field beneath a wide, cloud-streaked sky. Edgar Degas painted this countryside scene in 1869.
items.tags: carriage, horses, racecourse, family, countryside, oil painting
items.credit_line: fAG5E-YLY4Q57g at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Portrait of a Man (Diego Martelli), study
items.description_narrative: Little more than an underdrawing survives here — a bearded man's head and shoulders sketched thinly over a bare, warm-toned ground, much of the surface left untouched.
items.tags: study, sketch, underdrawing, unfinished, portrait

items.title: Head of a Man
items.description_narrative: A man's head emerges from a loosely brushed gray ground, his dark hair tousled and a thin mustache above softly parted lips. His downcast eyes and slightly turned face give the sketch a private, unposed quality. Bare paper left visible around the figure keeps the focus entirely on his expression.
items.tags: portrait study, drawing, head, sketch, charcoal, impressionism, figure study

items.title: Horseman Seen from Behind, with Spurs
items.description_narrative: Seen directly from behind, a rider in a black top hat and coat sits still atop a pale, cream-colored horse. Loose, smoky brushwork blurs horse and rider into a soft haze of greens and browns. The horse's hindquarters and legs, planted firmly, anchor the otherwise atmospheric composition.
items.tags: horseman, equestrian, rider, figure study, muted tones, impressionism, horse

items.title: Diego Martelli
items.description_narrative: A bearded man looks down and to the side, rendered in charcoal and white chalk with heavy shading around his brow and beard. This is Diego Martelli, the Italian art critic who championed the Impressionists and whose writing on their 1879 exhibition helped bring the movement wider attention. Degas made many studies of Martelli that year; this sheet relates to two painted portraits, one now in Edinburgh and the other in Buenos Aires.
items.tags: diego martelli, portrait, degas, charcoal, drawing, impressionism, art critic

items.title: After the Bath: Woman Drying Herself
items.description_narrative: A woman perched at the edge of a low chair draws a towel across her back with both arms raised, the whole scene glowing in warm ochres, greens, and touches of yellow from a patterned curtain behind her. Edgar Degas made this pastel between about 1890 and 1895.
items.tags: degas, pastel, bather, warm palette, seated figure, towel

items.title: Beach Scene
items.medium: Oil on paper mounted on canvas
items.description_narrative: A woman combs out a young girl's hair as she lies on the sand beneath an open umbrella, hats and folded clothes scattered nearby. Bathers, strolling figures, and small sailboats dot the beach and pale green sea behind them. Edgar Degas painted this beach scene in the 1870s.
items.tags: beach, hair combing, umbrella, seaside, impressionism, oil sketch

items.title: Promenade Beside the Sea
items.description_narrative: Two riders in tall top hats move along a sandy coastal path, seen from behind as their horses carry them toward pale cliffs and a hazy sea. Soft grays and warm ochres blur sky, water, and shore into one quiet, atmospheric scene.
items.tags: seaside, horses, riders, coastal path, muted palette, early degas

items.title: Ukrainian Dancers
items.description_narrative: Three dancers in white blouses and patterned skirts move together across a grassy ground, one flinging a leg out mid-step, ribbons and floral embroidery trailing from their hair and shoulders. Quick, vivid strokes of pastel in orange, green, and blue capture the whirl of the folk dance.
items.tags: dancers, folk costume, pastel, degas, movement, late work

items.title: Combing the Hair (La Coiffure)
items.description_narrative: A woman tips her head back as a maid in pale pink draws a comb through her loose red hair, the two figures set against a glowing field of orange-red. Both women's forms blur into the background color, so the comb's motion and the sweep of hair become the real subject rather than either face. A small dish and bottle sit on the white cloth below, the few solid objects in an otherwise dissolving scene.
items.tags: hairdressing, degas, domestic scene, impressionism, intimate, red palette, genre painting

items.title: Paul Lafond and Alphonse Cherfils Examining a Painting
items.description_narrative: Two men in dark coats and hats lean close together, examining a small painting on an easel. The canvas is dedicated 'to his dear friends' — a future museum curator and an art collector who championed the Impressionists.
items.tags: portrait, friendship, collectors, impressionism

items.title: Study for a Portrait of Hélène Rouart
items.description_narrative: A woman in a long blue dress stands beside a wooden chair, one hand resting on its back and the other holding a pair of gloves and a furled umbrella. Sketched in colored pencil with loose, searching lines, the drawing leaves the background barely indicated behind her.
items.tags: portrait study, drawing, degas, figure sketch, blue dress

items.title: Madame Jeantaud in the Mirror
items.description_narrative: A woman in profile sits beside a mirror that doubles her image at left, where her reflection seems to look away entirely. A blue porcelain vase glows at her side against the dim, mirrored room.
items.tags: portrait, mirror, reflection, fashion, impressionism
items.credit_line: BgFg1OUqjIILuA at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Visit to a Museum
items.description_narrative: Two women in dark green dresses stand together before a gallery wall, one tilting her head back to study a painting overhead while the other, seated on a bench, pages through an open guidebook. Warm ochre light fills the gallery, with glimpses of colorful canvases visible behind them.
items.tags: museum, gallery, degas, modern life, women
items.credit_line: uQEaGdRyVjwCfg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Interior (The Rape)
items.description_narrative: A woman crouches at the edge of a chair, shoulders drawn in, while a man in a dark coat stands rigid near the door across the room. A single lamp glows on a round table between them, a strip of white cloth crumpled on the floor. Rose-patterned wallpaper and a neatly made bed frame the tense, wordless standoff.
items.tags: interior, tension, lamplight, figures, narrative scene, impressionism, bedroom
items.credit_line: wwFhoXRQJtHYJg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Billiard Room at Ménil-Hubert
items.description_narrative: An empty billiard table with three balls in play sits at the center of a warmly lit room, its ochre walls crowded with framed paintings. A doorway at left opens onto another softly lit interior beyond. Edgar Degas painted this billiard room at Ménil-Hubert in 1892.
items.tags: interior, billiard room, still life, impressionism, oil painting
items.credit_line: JAG3ooF4xPp0tg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: In a Café (L'Absinthe)
items.description_narrative: A weary woman in a feathered hat stares blankly past a glass of pale liquid, while a mustached man beside her puffs a pipe and looks the opposite way. Marble-topped tables and mirrored walls stretch the empty cafe around them. The pair's averted gazes and slack postures suggest isolation shared in silence.
items.tags: cafe, absinthe, isolation, figures, interior, impressionism, modern life
items.credit_line: GQH1c-43xR3JtA at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Portrait of the Art Critic Durand-Gréville
items.description_narrative: A balding, grey-bearded man looks directly out at the viewer, his coat rendered in broad dark strokes against a loosely worked, unfinished-looking ground.
items.tags: portrait, critic, beard, unfinished, impressionism

items.title: The Star (L'Étoile)
items.description_narrative: A ballerina in a white tutu balances on one pointed foot, arms outstretched, flowers pinned in her hair, caught mid-turn on a sunlit stage. In the wings behind her, a man in a dark suit stands watching alongside other dancers, the rocky painted backdrop glowing amber and green.
items.tags: ballet, dancer, pastel, degas, stage, motion

items.title: Bedtime (Le Coucher)
items.description_narrative: A nude figure bends over a rumpled white sheet on a pink-draped bed, long hair falling forward as she seems to smooth or search the cloth with both hands. Loose, sketchy brown and red-chalk lines leave much of the paper bare. This pastel of a bedtime scene is dated 1883 and attributed to Edgar Degas.
items.tags: bedtime, nude, pastel, sketch, domestic scene, impressionism

items.title: Toilette After the Bath
items.description_narrative: A woman in a white cap holds open a large white towel, waiting as a nude figure steps toward her, one leg and hip visible at the edge of the scene. Soft strokes of blue and white build the drapery's folds against a shadowed interior.
items.tags: bather, toilette, pastel, degas, interior scene
items.credit_line: fQEGqK2IxtPRoQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Woman at Her Dressing Table
items.description_narrative: A woman in a flowing blue dress sits before a dressing table, both arms raised as she works a comb through her loose brown hair. A small mirror, cup, and dish rest on the white tablecloth beside her, the room glowing in warm ochre and rust tones.
items.tags: toilette, dressing table, pastel, degas, domestic scene

items.title: After the Bath
items.description_narrative: A woman bends low over her own knee, one arm braced behind her, working a white cloth around her leg while patches of golden ochre and electric blue build up the space around her. Edgar Degas made this pastel around 1886.
items.tags: degas, pastel, bather, dynamic pose, blue and gold, nude study

items.title: Monsieur and Madame Édouard Manet
items.description_narrative: A bare, unpainted strip runs down the right edge of this double portrait, as though part of the scene had gone missing. A man in a dark suit reclines full length on a sofa, while a woman in a striped grey dress appears near a piano at right, partly swallowed by the blank passage beside her.
items.tags: portrait, double portrait, sofa, unfinished, impressionism

items.title: Lorenzo Pagans and Auguste De Gas
items.description_narrative: A seated man in a dark coat looks down at another man standing behind him, who holds up a sheet of music or paper between them. Loose, warm brushwork built from browns, oranges and near-black shadow gives the small interior scene an intimate hush.
items.tags: portrait, degas, double portrait, interior, warm palette, music

items.title: At the Milliner's
items.medium: Pastel on paper mounted on board
items.description_narrative: A woman ties her bonnet ribbons at her throat while a shop assistant beside her holds out a hat trimmed in bright red plumage. A curved yellow chair fills the foreground, its cool blue outline cutting across the warm interior. The sitter is identified as Mary Cassatt in this pastel Edgar Degas made around 1882.
items.tags: milliner, hat shop, pastel, portrait, mary cassatt, impressionism
items.current_repository: The Museum of Modern Art, New York

items.title: Breakfast After the Bath
items.description_narrative: A bent nude figure towels her back dry, her form built from loose crosshatched strokes of ochre and rose pastel. Beside her a clothed woman in yellow holds out a large cloth in one hand and a blue-patterned cup and saucer in the other, waiting. Degas leaves the setting almost bare, just a warm wash of orange behind them, so the two figures and the exchange between them carry the whole scene.
items.tags: bather, pastel, nude, morning routine, degas, impressionism, warm tones

items.title: Seascape with Sandy Beach at Low Tide
items.description_narrative: A wide, nearly empty beach stretches out at low tide beneath a vast, cloud-filled sky, its sand rendered in soft pink and tan pastel. Tiny figures dot the shoreline in the middle distance, dwarfed by the breadth of sea and sky.
items.tags: beach, low tide, pastel, degas, seascape, muted palette

items.title: Dancer Adjusting Her Shoe
items.description_narrative: A dancer bends low over her own knee, adjusting the ribbon of her ballet slipper, her white tutu bunching up around a bold band of blue. Degas builds her entire body from loose pastel strokes of pale blue and cream, leaving the background a rough wash of blue-gray. The pose is caught mid-motion, as though she paused only for a second before returning to the stage.
items.tags: ballet, dancer, pastel, degas, impressionism, shoe, backstage

items.title: The Convalescent
items.description_narrative: A woman in a dark brown shawl leans her head heavily into her hand, her pale face turned toward the viewer with a tired, faraway expression. Her white underdress is the brightest note in an otherwise somber, earth-toned painting. Degas gives her no setting to speak of, just enough dark space to suggest a sickroom chair.
items.tags: portrait, illness, degas, impressionism, somber, fatigue, interior
items.credit_line: EwEjiva1WNU2RQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Woman at Her Toilette (In Front of the Mirror)
items.description_narrative: A woman in a wide feathered hat raises one arm to adjust her hair before a mirror, brushes and a glass bottle arranged on the table beside her. Warm reddish tones fill the lower corner, suggesting a fur wrap draped nearby.
items.tags: toilette, mirror, pastel, degas, domestic scene

items.title: Woman Drying Her Left Leg
items.description_narrative: In loose red and black chalk, a bent nude figure leans over a blue basin, one arm reaching down toward a white cloth pooled at her feet. Streaks of pink hover over her shoulders like drapery, the paper left bare and warm-toned throughout.
items.tags: bather, drawing, degas, toilette, sketch

items.title: Dancers in the Wings
items.description_narrative: A cluster of dancers in pale tutus gathers just offstage, one figure bent forward while the others wait beside her. A long strip of stage floor stretches away to the right, gilded box seats glowing faintly in the background. Degas paints the whole scene in warm, chalky pastel, the dancers reduced to soft smudges of white, cream, and pink against the dim wings.

items.title: Woman Bathing
items.description_narrative: A woman stands with both arms raised, pressing a small white cloth to the crown of her head as long reddish-brown hair spills over one shoulder. Loose strokes of blue and green build a shadowed backdrop behind her bare back.
items.tags: bather, pastel, degas, toilette, nude

items.title: Bathers
items.description_narrative: Two nude figures rest together on the grass, one curled forward with her head propped on a rolled cloth, the other's leg braced against a third figure's leg at the picture's edge. Loose crosshatched strokes of green, blue, and flesh tones build the sunlit scene. Edgar Degas made this pastel study of bathers.
items.tags: bathers, nude, pastel, sketch, impressionism, grass

items.title: Woman Drying Herself (1884)
items.description_narrative: In sanguine chalk on cream paper, a seated nude woman reaches up to grip a white cloth draped over an unseen support, one leg drawn up beneath her. Patches of blue and burnt orange wash color into the background around her outlined form.
items.tags: bather, drawing, degas, toilette, sanguine

items.title: Sulking (Bouderie)
items.description_narrative: A woman in a grey dress trimmed with maroon leans against the back of a chair, glancing sidelong at the viewer, while a man in a dark coat sits absorbed in paperwork at a cluttered desk beside her. A framed picture of a horse race hangs on the wood-paneled wall behind them.
items.tags: genre scene, office interior, degas, narrative painting, realism

items.title: Women Combing Their Hair
items.description_narrative: Three women in loose white shifts comb out their long hair outdoors on a sandy bank, grass and trees rising behind them. Edgar Degas painted this scene around 1875; it belongs to the Phillips Collection.
items.tags: hair combing, women, outdoors, impressionism, degas, oil on paper, toilette

items.title: Seated Violin Player
items.description_narrative: A bearded man sits with a violin tucked under his chin and bow raised, a cane resting against his leg, worked in warm brown strokes over visible pencil underdrawing on tinted paper. Edgar Degas made this study in 1872.

items.title: After the Bath: Seated Woman Drying Herself
items.description_narrative: Seated against a red-patterned pillow, a woman leans forward with her head lowered into a towel, her bare back the sketch's central mass of soft charcoal shading. Edgar Degas drew this in 1885.

items.title: Village Street, Saint-Valery-sur-Somme
items.description_narrative: A quiet village street runs between weathered stone houses and tall trees, their forms softened into a hazy blur of grey and green. Warm light filters through the branches onto a grassy path, the whole scene rendered in loose, atmospheric strokes.

items.title: Horses in a Meadow
items.description_narrative: A dark brown horse and a pale gray horse stand rump to rump in a wide meadow, swishing at flies as they graze. Beyond them a river reflects low houses with smoking chimneys, while faint horses and cattle dot the far hillside. Soft, hazy color unifies the whole rural scene.

items.title: The Riders
items.description_narrative: A line of jockeys in bright caps of yellow, red, and blue walk their horses across an open green field, spectators and a top-hatted figure watching from the margins. Loose, quick brushwork blurs the horses' legs into motion even as they stand still.
items.tags: jockeys, horses, degas, racecourse, loose brushwork

items.title: Two Women
items.description_narrative: Two women in pink skirts and blue wraps lean and gesture animatedly in a warmly lit room, one with her head tilted back as if mid-laugh. Behind them, potted plants sit on a table draped in vivid red and gold, the walls streaked with loose, warm-toned strokes.

items.title: Lady with a Dog
items.description_narrative: Seen close in profile, a woman tilts her head beneath a wide, ribboned straw hat, its brim curling upward in loose swirls of cream and grey paint. Beside her, a shaggy brown dog's head emerges from the shadow, rendered in the same quick, unfinished strokes — more a sketch than a polished portrait.

items.current_repository: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design

items.title: Achille De Gas in the Uniform of a Cadet
items.description_narrative: A young man in a dark naval cadet's uniform trimmed with gold braid and buttons leans against a low wall, his cap set at a formal angle, set against a warm red interior. Edgar Degas painted this portrait around the 1850s.

items.title: René De Gas
items.description_narrative: A solemn boy with large brown eyes and neatly combed dark hair looks directly at the viewer, dressed in a black jacket and a white collar tied with a black bow. items.title: Young Woman with Her Hand over Her Mouth
items.description_narrative: A young woman with reddish hair and flushed, half-closed eyes presses the back of her hand to her mouth, wrapped in a dark cloak. Edgar Degas painted this portrait around 1875; it belongs to the Metropolitan Museum of Art.

items.description_narrative: Outdoors on a patch of grass, a bather pulls a towel up over her head, her weight braced on one hip beside dark drapery and a tree trunk. Edgar Degas made this pastel in 1885; it belongs to the National Gallery of Art.

items.title: Girl Drying Herself
items.description_narrative: Seen from behind, a nude figure drapes a white towel over her shoulders and head, one foot lifted onto a low stone. Grass and a tree trunk fill the background in loose, chalky strokes. The pastel's dry texture catches every plane of the bather's stance.

items.title: Café-Concert
items.description_narrative: A row of women in bright evening dress—pink, red, black, and yellow—fills a café-concert stage lit by strings of round lamps overhead. In the foreground a man's silhouette, a top hat, and the scroll of a double bass mark the edge of the orchestra pit, while a woman in yellow lifts a folded fan to her chin. Degas builds the scene almost entirely from chalky pastel strokes, the colors kept loose and unblended.

items.description_narrative: In warm ochre pastel, a woman appears in profile, a broad hat trimmed with pale ribbon framing her face above a heavy fur collar. Bare passages of toned paper stand in for light against the worked shadows.

items.title: Dancers at the Old Opera House
items.description_narrative: Two dancers in pale tutus wait in the wings, glimpsed from behind as they watch the stage. Degas renders the whole space in soft pastel, the dancers' bodies barely more solid than the architecture around them.

items.title: The Ballet Master (Le Maître de Ballet)
items.medium: Oil, essence, and pastel on paper
items.description_narrative: A ballet master leans on his cane, one arm outstretched as if giving direction, while a dancer executes a deep backward arch en pointe beside him. Rendered almost entirely in blacks, greys, and chalky whites, the scene has the hushed, smoky look of a rehearsal after dark. Edgar Degas made this study around 1874, working with Ludovic-Napoléon Lepic.

items.title: Woman Drying Her Left Arm
items.description_narrative: A seated nude woman leans forward, one arm extended along a large white towel that drapes down to the floor. Mottled blue-green pastel fills the background, with a patterned red-and-blue rug visible in the lower corner.
items.tags: bather, pastel, degas, toilette, nude

items.title: Three Seated Women (Brothel Scene)
items.description_narrative: Three women with elaborate hairstyles sit close together, their bare shoulders and chests rendered in loose, smudged strokes of grey and warm red-brown. Worked as a monotype, the image has a soft, ghostly quality, with thick dark hair framing each face.
items.tags: monotype, figures, degas, interior, muted palette

items.title: Cotton Merchants in New Orleans
items.description_narrative: Men in dark suits and hats lean over and around a long table piled high with raw white cotton, one inspecting a handful between his fingers. A framed seascape hangs on the pale wall behind them, an odd note of open water amid the close, businesslike interior. Degas paints the scene as a study in textures, the cotton's soft bulk against the men's crisp collars and hard hat brims.
items.tags: cotton, merchants, degas, new orleans, interior, impressionism, commerce

items.title: Bather Drying Herself
items.description_narrative: A nude figure bends sharply forward, drying herself with a cloth beside a round tub, rendered in loose charcoal strokes with only a flush of red at the upper edge. Large areas of the paper are left bare, giving the sketch an unfinished, spontaneous energy. Edgar Degas made this study of a bather.
items.tags: bather, nude, sketch, charcoal, study, impressionism

items.title: Woman Drying Her Arm
items.description_narrative: Seated on a cushion patterned in yellow and green, a nude woman reaches her arm up and across her body, gripping a pale cloth against a screen of dense foliage. Warm flesh tones stand out against the cool teal-green background built from dense strokes of pastel.
items.tags: bather, pastel, degas, toilette, nude

items.title: Male Nude (Academic Study)
items.description_narrative: A young man lies stretched across a bare table, one arm bent behind his head, the other trailing off the table's edge — a study in anatomy and shadow, its background left dark and largely unfinished.
items.tags: academic study, male nude, figure study, unfinished, anatomy

items.title: Landscape
items.description_narrative: Soft bands of green, blue, and lavender pastel describe rolling hills and a pale road curving through a valley, the forms blurred as if seen through mist. Edgar Degas made this landscape around 1892, working pastel over a monotype print.

items.description_narrative: Two ballet dancers stand close together, seen from behind at the shoulders, one reaching to adjust the strap of her bodice while the other looks toward her. Warm hair and cool green-blue shadows are built up in dense, overlapping strokes of pastel.

items.title: Woman Drying Her Foot
items.description_narrative: A seated nude woman draws one knee up and reaches toward a pale blue-and-white cloth resting against a cushion, her long auburn hair falling loose over her shoulder. Bold orange and blue strokes build the striped backdrop behind her curved pose.

items.description_narrative: Two studies of the same young woman's face share the sheet: one fully worked in soft browns and pinks, gazing steadily out; the other a paler, more roughly sketched profile beside it. Loose strokes of white drift around both heads like unfinished cloud. Edgar Degas made this double portrait study in 1873.

items.description_narrative: A nude woman tilts her head back as a maid in a pink dress stands behind her, gathering and combing her hair. She sits on a white cloth draped over a tufted yellow ottoman, the whole room glowing in warm mustard and gold pastel tones.

items.title: Bather Stepping into a Tub
items.description_narrative: A woman leans far forward over the rim of a tub, one arm braced against its edge and the other reaching down into the water below. Warm orange and ochre strokes fill the room around her, applied in loose, visible hatching. Edgar Degas made this pastel around 1890.

items.title: Woman with a Towel
items.description_narrative: A woman seen from behind pats herself dry with a large white towel, her hair loose against a warm golden wall. Edgar Degas made this pastel in the 1890s; it belongs to the Metropolitan Museum of Art.

items.title: The Chemin de l'Écluse and the Pontoise Bridge
items.description_narrative: A man and woman walk together along a riverside path, a stone bridge and cluster of village rooftops rising behind them under a pale sky. A factory chimney sends up a thin trail of smoke on the far bank, a quiet note of industry beside the rural houses. Pissarro paints the couple small against the wide expanse of sky and water, in soft, muted tones.
items.tags: bridge, river, pissarro, landscape, figures, impressionism, village

items.title: Landscape near Pontoise, the Auvers Road
items.description_narrative: Two women carrying baskets walk along a dirt road in the foreground, while further up a man leads a horse past scattered houses on a green hillside. Tall poplars frame the road at right beneath a sky piled with soft white clouds. Pissarro painted the road near Pontoise in 1881.
items.tags: landscape, pontoise, pissarro, road, figures, hillside village

items.title: The Louvre, Afternoon, Rainy Weather
items.description_narrative: Rain softens every edge of this view along a wide river toward a grand stone building on the far bank; barges work the current beneath a bridge, and bare trees along the embankment show the first blush of spring buds. The work's title marks it as the first in a series of views of this scene.
items.tags: paris, seine, louvre, cityscape, rain, river, bridge, impressionism
items.credit_line: National Gallery of Art, Washington, D. C., online collection

items.title: The Old Mill in Knokke
items.description_narrative: A windmill and a slender church spire rise together above a village, a man and woman pushing a handcart along the grassy foreground path beneath a heavy, clouded sky.
items.tags: windmill, village, landscape, clouds, impressionism

items.title: Afternoon Break, Girl and Young Peasant Woman Resting
items.description_narrative: A young woman in a blue skirt and red bonnet reclines on a grassy slope beneath slender trees while a girl in a straw hat sits nearby eating a piece of bread. Camille Pissarro painted this rural rest in 1882.
items.tags: pissarro, peasant life, countryside, reclining figure, oil painting, rural

items.title: Rue de l'Hermitage, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A woman in a rust-colored shawl walks down a sunlit village street lined with whitewashed walls and red-tiled roofs, another figure standing near a gate at the roadside. Tall trees and drifting clouds rise above the rooftops in a pale sky.
items.tags: street scene, village, pissarro, figures, early work

items.title: Landscape, Ile-de-France
items.description_narrative: Two gleaners pause in a pale gold stubble field dotted with conical haystacks stretching toward the horizon. Soft clouds drift across a wide blue sky above the flat, sunlit plain. Pissarro painted the harvest scene in 1873.
items.tags: landscape, harvest, pissarro, haystacks, impressionism, rural

items.title: The Pink House, Knokke
items.description_narrative: A steep red-tiled roof and tall whitewashed chimney rise over a cottage, a cart wheel resting against its wall while two figures pause together on the path at left.
items.tags: cottage, roof, chimney, village, landscape, impressionism

items.title: The Orchard
items.description_narrative: White blossom crowds the branches of an orchard in full bloom, a figure gathering fallen wood at left and another walking the grassy path between the trees.
items.tags: orchard, blossom, spring, landscape, impressionism
items.credit_line: National Gallery of Art, Washington, D. C.

items.title: In the Vegetable Garden
items.description_narrative: A woman carries two woven baskets past rows of leafy vegetables, a small child in a red dress trotting close beside her. A distant figure bends over the crop further down the path, beneath a terraced hillside dotted with trees. Bright, broken brushstrokes of green and gold fill the entire garden.
items.tags: vegetable garden, mother and child, rural labor, landscape, impressionism, harvest, baskets

items.title: The Hermitage Gardens, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: White houses with red-tiled roofs climb a wooded hillside above a neat kitchen garden, its rows of vegetables tended by two small, distant figures. Billowing clouds fill most of the sky above the village. Bright, even light gives the whole scene a calm, everyday clarity.
items.tags: village, garden, hillside, landscape, impressionism, houses, clouds

items.title: Ploughed Land
items.description_narrative: A single plough sits abandoned in the middle of a freshly turned field, its dark earth taking up most of the canvas; a cart and a scatter of small figures wait near the tree line beyond.
items.tags: ploughed field, plough, cart, farmland, landscape, impressionism

items.title: Young Peasant Girls Resting in the Fields near Pontoise
items.description_narrative: Two peasant women in headscarves rest in a grassy field lined with slender trees, cattle grazing behind them in the distance. Pissarro painted this in 1882; the canvas is held by the National Gallery of Art.
items.tags: peasant women, rural life, field, impressionism, pissarro, oil painting, rest

items.title: Houses at Bougival, Autumn
items.description_narrative: A woman with a basket over her arm pauses on a garden path to speak with a boy carrying a satchel, tall bare-limbed trees rising above them. White houses with red roofs cluster just beyond the rows of cultivated ground. Cool gray sky and thinning foliage give the scene an autumn hush.
items.tags: autumn, village, woman and child, garden, houses, impressionism, rural life

items.title: Peasant Woman
items.description_narrative: A red-and-white kerchief frames a peasant woman's face as she stands with one hand resting on her hip, foliage dissolving into brushstrokes of green behind her.

items.title: Orchards at Louveciennes

items.tags: village, path, trees, landscape, impressionism

items.title: Peasant Woman Carrying Two Bundles of Hay
items.description_narrative: A peasant woman pauses on a path with a bundle of hay gripped in each hand, a whitewashed cottage and bare autumn trees behind her.
items.tags: peasant, hay, labor, rural, impressionism

items.title: Apple Harvest, Éragny
items.description_narrative: Four figures gather apples beneath a broad tree, one reaching overhead with a hooked pole while others stoop to fill baskets at the trunk. items.title: Chestnut Grove, Louveciennes
items.description_narrative: Bare chestnut trees fan out in tangled branches against a clear blue sky, their winter silhouettes filling most of the canvas. items.title: Route d'Ennery
items.description_narrative: A horse pulls a cart with two seated figures along a path crossing a small stone bridge, where two women pause to watch. Rolling green hills, grazing sheep, and tall poplar trees stretch into a hazy distance under a pale sky.
items.tags: landscape, bridge, horse cart, pissarro, hills, rural

items.title: Lordship Lane Station, Dulwich
items.description_narrative: A steam locomotive trails a plume of white smoke as it curves along the tracks past rows of brick houses on a green embankment. Soft grey clouds drift over the suburban hillside in the quiet afternoon light. Pissarro painted the scene in 1871.

items.title: The Big Walnut Tree, Autumn Morning, Éragny
items.description_narrative: A large tree with sparse autumn leaves in red and gold rises above a screen of green shrubs, a red-roofed house nestled just behind it. items.title: Banks of the Seine at Port-Marly
items.description_narrative: A red-roofed house and two tall, spindly trees rise behind a calm stretch of river where small boats drift and figures wade near the bank. items.title: The Hay Harvest, Éragny
items.description_narrative: A woman in a red blouse rakes hay atop a golden haystack, her figure built from countless small, distinct dabs of color. items.title: View from Louveciennes
items.description_narrative: A wide dirt road curves past flowering trees and a distant stone aqueduct, two small figures making their way along its edge. Billowing white clouds dominate more than half the canvas, dwarfing the quiet village scene below.

items.title: Julie Pissarro in the Garden
items.description_narrative: Seated in a garden chair, a woman in a pale grey-blue dress looks off to the side, a thin red ribbon knotted at her throat and her hands folded loosely in her lap. items.tags: portrait, boy, child, hat, early work

items.title: Landscape at Saint-Charles, near Gisors, Sunset
items.description_narrative: A dazzling sun glows low behind a cluster of tall, feathery trees, casting long shadows across a grassy path that curves past a small cottage. items.tags: landscape, sunset, pissarro, trees, impressionism, golden light

items.title: June Morning at Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A dirt track cuts diagonally through golden fields toward a huddle of small farm buildings, where two or three tiny figures make their way along the path. Billowing white clouds crowd a pale summer sky above a low, hazy horizon, with a single tall, slender tree standing at the field's edge. Pissarro painted the scene in 1873.
items.tags: landscape, pontoise, pissarro, wheat field, impressionism, summer sky, rural path

items.title: A Cowherd at Valhermeil, Auvers-sur-Oise
items.description_narrative: A woman leads a cow along a dirt path below sloped, terraced hillsides, a horse-drawn wagon and a cluster of farm buildings visible further down the road. Pissarro fills the upper half of the canvas with the patchwork fields of the hillside, each strip a slightly different shade of green and ochre. Tall poplars line the ridge above, their thin trunks breaking up the wide summer sky.
items.tags: farm, cowherd, pissarro, countryside, impressionism, hillside, rural life

items.title: Landscape
items.description_narrative: A dense tree with dark, layered foliage dominates the left side of the composition, its shadow reaching across a quiet green field toward a small farmhouse with an orange-tiled roof. Sparse, bare branches trail down the right edge beneath a pale, clouded sky. Pissarro painted the scene in 1864.
items.tags: landscape, farmhouse, pissarro, tree, muted palette, countryside

items.title: The Little Country Maid
items.description_narrative: A young maid in a striped blouse sweeps the floor with a long-handled broom, while a child peers over the edge of a round table set with a teapot and cups. Warm red chairs and a doorway frame the quiet domestic interior. Pissarro painted the scene in 1882.
items.tags: genre scene, pissarro, domestic interior, maid, child, impressionism

items.title: The Pork Butcher
items.description_narrative: Under an awning strung with hanging meat, a woman in a white apron cuts at her market stall while customers crowd around her.
items.tags: market, butcher, labor, genre scene, impressionism

items.title: Two Women Chatting by the Sea, St. Thomas
items.description_narrative: Two women walk along a sandy coastal path, one carrying a basket and the other holding a white cloth aloft to shield them from the sun. Low hills curve along the shoreline behind them, with a few small figures visible near the water's edge.
items.tags: coastal scene, st thomas, pissarro, early work, figures
items.credit_line: National Gallery of Art, Washington, D. C. – The Collection – Two Women Chatting by the Sea, St. Thomas

items.title: Two Young Peasant Women
items.description_narrative: Two women in a sunlit orchard pause in conversation, one seated with her chin resting on her hand and the other standing, leaning on a wooden pole, a red-patterned kerchief tied over her hair. Dense dabs of green, gold, and violet build the grass and rows of trees into a shimmering field of light.
items.tags: peasant women, pissarro, pointillism, orchard, rural life

items.title: Portrait of Félix in a Skirt
items.description_narrative: A child with long brown hair and a shy, direct gaze sits with hands crossed in the lap of a dark skirt, against a plain warm ground.
items.tags: child, portrait, family, hair, impressionism

items.title: In the Garden of Les Mathurins, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: Thick clusters of red, pink, and white flowers crowd the foreground of a walled garden, framed by cypress and leafy trees. A white house with red chimneys peeks through the greenery on the left, beneath a bright blue sky scattered with clouds. Dense, varied brushwork captures the garden's lush overgrowth.
items.tags: garden, flowers, cottage, landscape, impressionism, summer, cypress
items.credit_line: [1], Picture prepared for Wikipedia by Adrian Pingstone in April 2003.

items.title: The Poultry Market, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: Women crowd close together at a poultry market, their backs turned to the viewer as they haggle over baskets of live birds — a single hen pecks at the ground near a woven basket in the foreground.
items.tags: market, poultry, women, basket, genre scene, impressionism

items.title: Two Women Kneeling at the Wash-House
items.description_narrative: Two women kneel at a stone wash-house beside the water, one scrubbing linen on a slab while the other bends nearby, a woven basket at her side. Loose washes of blue and green sketch the water and stone arches, with a third figure glimpsed passing behind a pillar.
items.tags: washerwomen, laundry, pissarro, watercolor, genre scene

items.title: The Louvre Under Snow
items.description_narrative: Camille Pissarro painted this snowy view of the Seine in 1902; it belongs to the National Gallery. Frost-covered trees line a stone embankment overlooking a wide river dotted with small boats, a bridge and distant rooftops fading into a hazy grey sky.
items.tags: pissarro, impressionism, cityscape, seine, snow scene, national gallery, late work, paris

items.title: Still Life
items.description_narrative: A dark jug, a half-filled wineglass, and a loaf of bread sit beside a shallow bowl of food on a white tablecloth, two ladles hanging on the ochre wall behind. Apples or pears rest between the bread and the bowl, the arrangement painted in warm, earthy tones.
items.tags: still life, jug, bread, pissarro, early work, earthy palette
items.credit_line: CwGUil8Y-ec2FQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Village of Knokke
items.description_narrative: Red-roofed cottages cluster around a church with a tall bell tower, its spire rising above a screen of trees. Neat rows of cultivated green fields fill the foreground, stretching toward the village beneath a soft grey sky.
items.tags: village, pissarro, knokke, church, landscape

items.title: Vegetable Garden
items.description_narrative: Bare tree branches frame a view through an orchard toward a cream-colored house with a blue slate roof. A man in a dark coat walks among neat rows of cabbages planted in the garden below, morning light picking out the bare limbs overhead.
items.tags: vegetable garden, pissarro, orchard, landscape, rural life
items.credit_line: Google Arts & Culture: Home page – Image

items.title: Peasants' Houses, Éragny
items.description_narrative: Tightly worked dots of color build a row of houses, their tiled roofs glowing warm against blue sky, a woman pausing near a garden gate below.
items.tags: village, houses, pointillism, landscape, impressionism
items.credit_line: QgGHxgs5iZgNnA at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level
items.current_repository: Art Gallery of New South Wales

items.title: The Seine at Bougival
items.description_narrative: A tree-lined avenue runs along the riverbank, a lone woman walking beneath bare branches while small boats rest in the reeds below. Across the water, a white house and distant hills glow under a soft pink evening sky.
items.tags: seine, river, avenue, pissarro, landscape, evening light
items.credit_line: Google Arts & Culture: Home page – QQHISYDhTvHr4Q Image

items.title: Poultry Market at Gisors
items.description_narrative: A crowd fills a market square beneath tall trees, women in white bonnets bargaining and bending over baskets of live poultry at their feet. The chalky texture throughout comes from a mix of tempera and pastel.
items.tags: market, poultry, pastel, genre scene, impressionism
items.credit_line: -QFl_G1j8hU_fw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Sunlight on the Road, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A man rides a pale horse down a sunlit country road, while a woman and child walk together near a stand of tall, slender trees. Houses cluster among greenery in the distance under a sky filled with soft white clouds.
items.tags: road, pissarro, horse, figures, landscape, sunlight
items.credit_line: -AGrVa_YXRnPkw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Railway Crossing at Les Pâtis, near Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A man and woman pause on a sunlit road beside a wooden level-crossing gate, a stone wall and a gabled house with a red door just ahead. Long shadows and warm ochre tones suggest late-afternoon light settling over the quiet lane.
items.tags: level crossing, road, pissarro, figures, landscape, warm light

items.title: Factory at Saint-Ouen-l'Aumône, the Flood of the Oise
items.description_narrative: Floodwater has risen to swallow the base of a stand of trees, their bare branches poking up out of the still, pale water in the foreground. Across the flood, a factory's smokestacks send up thin trails of smoke beside a cluster of low roofs, a small red flag marking a boat or post at the water's edge. This is the Oise in flood, painted in soft, sandy tones with sky and water nearly the same warm gray.
items.tags: flood, oise river, factory, pissarro, landscape, impressionism, industry

items.title: Route de Saint-Antoine à L'Hermitage, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A dirt road curves past a tall stone wall and a red-roofed house, where a horse-drawn cart makes its way beneath a screen of tall trees. Two figures and a small dog pause at the roadside, the green hillside opening out beyond the wall toward distant fields.
items.tags: road, village, trees, horse-drawn cart, pissarro, landscape

items.title: View of Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A dirt road leads toward a distant hilltop town crowned by a tall church spire, riders and a horse-drawn cart making their way along the path. Fields and scattered trees stretch out under a wide, softly clouded sky.
items.tags: landscape, pissarro, pontoise, panoramic view, road

items.title: The Lock at Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A barge sits moored below a canal lock, its still water reflecting a row of houses and tall, slender poplars along the bank. Billowing clouds fill most of the wide sky above the quiet waterway. Pissarro painted the scene in 1872.
items.tags: landscape, pontoise, pissarro, canal, barge, impressionism

items.title: Peasant Woman Digging, the Jardin de Maubuisson, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A woman in a red kerchief drives a spade into the soil of a kitchen garden, rows of cabbages spreading behind her; a second figure bends low among the plants further back.
items.tags: kitchen garden, spade, cabbages, labor, rural, impressionism

items.title: Landscape at Les Pâtis, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A man in a straw hat walks a path along a wooden fence, looking out over a broad valley of cultivated hillside fields and a distant hazy village. A tall, slender tree rises beside the path, and heavy white clouds pile up in a bright summer sky. Pissarro painted the view in 1868.
items.tags: landscape, pontoise, pissarro, valley, farmland, impressionism

items.title: The Little Bridge
items.description_narrative: A low stone arch bridges a quiet, shaded stream, its dark opening framed by tall, leaning tree trunks and thick undergrowth. Dappled light barely reaches the water below, giving the whole grove a cool, secluded hush. Pissarro painted the scene in 1875.
items.tags: landscape, pissarro, bridge, forest, stream, impressionism

items.title: The Donkey Ride at La Roche-Guyon
items.description_narrative: Two children stand watching as a woman and a man ride matched donkeys across an open field, a grazing cow and distant trees filling out the sunlit landscape behind them. Cliffs and a stretch of river glow pale in the distance, dissolving into a bright summer haze. Pissarro spreads the whole party wide across the canvas, the animals and riders small against the scale of the countryside.
items.tags: donkey ride, countryside, pissarro, la roche-guyon, landscape, impressionism, rural life

items.title: The Heights of l'Hautil Road to Rouen, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A woman in a dark dress holds a wide straw hat as a small child in white clings to her side, both looking out over patchwork fields below. A pale road winds down through the valley toward distant hills. Autumn color mutes the landscape into soft rust and green tones.
items.tags: parasol, mother and child, landscape, road, hillside view, impressionism, valley

items.title: The Orchard at Maubuisson, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: Rows of cabbages fill a kitchen garden, where two figures stand talking and a third crouches among the plants. A house with a steep red roof rises through the trees behind them.
items.tags: kitchen garden, cabbages, landscape, rural, impressionism

items.title: Harvesting Potatoes, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: Several women bend low over a rust-colored field, gathering potatoes into sacks while a terraced, autumn-toned hillside rises behind them. A white house with a red roof anchors the middle distance. Warm earth tones dominate the canvas, broken only by patches of green grass.
items.tags: potato harvest, rural labor, field, women, landscape, impressionism, farmland

items.title: The Quarry, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A lone woman in a headscarf and apron walks a path above a chalky white quarry cut into a green hillside, dense trees rising beside her. Dappled light filters through the leaves, softening the pale quarry scar into part of the pastoral view.
items.tags: quarry, landscape, woman, trees, pissarro, pastoral

items.title: View of the Côte des Gratte-Coqs, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A cluster of houses with pale walls and slate-blue roofs nestles into a green hillside, dense trees and shrubs crowding close on every side. A grassy path winds through the foreground, and a thin plume of smoke rises from one of the chimneys.
items.tags: landscape, pissarro, hillside, pontoise, village

items.title: The Quai du Pothuis at Pontoise after Rain
items.description_narrative: Heavy white clouds pile up over a rain-slicked road, where a factory chimney sends dark smoke drifting past a row of trees. A horse-drawn cart and a walking figure make their way past cottages under the storm-brightened sky, the wet ground catching pale light.
items.tags: rainy day, road, clouds, chimney smoke, pissarro, landscape

items.title: Banks of the Oise at Pontoise, Effect of Snow
items.description_narrative: Rows of pollarded willows stand bare against a pale winter sky, their trunks rising from a snow-dusted field. Two tall factory chimneys smoke faintly on the horizon behind scattered farm buildings. Camille Pissarro painted this snow effect along the Oise in 1879.
items.tags: winter, snow, willows, river, factory, landscape

items.title: Landscape at Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A pair of horses hauls a hay-laden cart along a worn field track, with several small figures walking alongside, under a broad, cloud-streaked sky. A solitary tree leans over the golden stubble field in the foreground. Pissarro painted the scene in 1872.
items.tags: landscape, pontoise, pissarro, hay cart, horses, impressionism

items.title: Factory at Saint-Ouen-l'Aumône
items.description_narrative: Smoke rises in thick gray plumes from a tall brick chimney beside a cluster of factory buildings with red-tiled roofs, a placid river running along the foreground. Slender poplars line the far bank, their thin trunks a quiet counterpoint to the industrial smoke above. Pissarro paints the factory as just another feature of the landscape, its chimney rising as naturally as the trees beside it.
items.tags: factory, industry, river, pissarro, landscape, impressionism, smoke
items.current_repository: Michele & Donald D'Amour Museum of Fine Arts

items.title: Le Semeur, Montfoucault
items.description_narrative: A man in a broad hat strides across a furrowed field with a woven basket slung at his hip, scattering seed by hand. Behind him, a pair of horses pulls a plough near the tree line under a pale, breezy sky. Pissarro painted the scene in 1875.
items.tags: genre scene, pissarro, sower, farmland, horses, rural labor

items.title: Farm at Montfoucault, Effect of Snow
items.description_narrative: A man carrying a bundle crosses a snowy farmyard toward an open gate, a sheep and two dark hens trailing behind him. Snow blankets every rooftop and fence rail, the stone farmhouse walls showing through in muted grays and ochres. Pissarro paints the whole yard in the flat, even light of an overcast winter day.
items.tags: snow, farm, winter, pissarro, montfoucault, impressionism, farmyard

items.title: Corner of the Garden at L'Hermitage, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: Two young girls sit together on a garden bench, nearly swallowed by the dense trees and shrubs rising around them. Flowering plants in pink, white, and red crowd the foreground path, while a factory chimney rises unexpectedly at the far right, just visible above the greenery. Pissarro lets the garden itself dominate the canvas, the girls reduced to two small, quiet figures within it.
items.tags: garden, children, pissarro, pontoise, impressionism, flowers, landscape

items.title: Louveciennes, Route de Saint-Germain
items.description_narrative: Pale, translucent washes sketch a country road lined with slender trees, a horse-drawn carriage and a lone walking figure receding into soft, hazy distance. Faint architecture rises at right beneath a wide, cloud-streaked sky. Pissarro painted the scene in 1871.
items.tags: landscape, pissarro, watercolor, country road, impressionism, figures

items.title: Morning Sunlight on the Snow, Éragny-sur-Epte
items.description_narrative: Long morning shadows stripe the snow gold and violet as a woman carries a bucket along a path lined with tall, bare poplars. The setting is identified as Éragny-sur-Epte.
items.tags: snow, winter, morning light, landscape, impressionism
items.credit_line: rAHp1qgFEGK2IA at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Effect of Snow at Montfoucault
items.description_narrative: A woman and a small child walk together along a snow-covered path, bundled in dark winter clothing beneath a stand of bare, twisting trees. A mound of hay or thatch, dusted with the same snow, sits beside a low stone wall, and a house appears through the branches to the right. Pissarro renders the snow in thick strokes of white and pale green, the sky and ground blending into one cold, overcast light.
items.tags: snow, winter, montfoucault, pissarro, figures, landscape, impressionism

items.title: Landscape, St. Thomas
items.description_narrative: Tall coconut palms and a spiky agave plant frame two figures pausing on a dirt path above a sun-bleached tropical valley, with low hills fading into haze beyond. Warm ochre tones and a pale sky suggest the heat of midday. Pissarro painted the scene in 1856.
items.tags: landscape, pissarro, tropical, palm trees, caribbean, figures

items.title: Autumn, Éragny
items.description_narrative: Two houses with red chimney pots rise behind a screen of golden autumn trees, their branches feathered with strokes of amber and green. A low hedge and open lawn lead the eye toward the scene. This view is attributed to Camille Pissarro.
items.tags: autumn, houses, trees, chimney, impressionism, landscape

items.title: Effect of Snow at Éragny
items.description_narrative: Bare orchard trees stand in rows across a snow-dusted field, their thin trunks and branches fading into a pale, misty distance. A line of pollarded willows marches along the left edge, while rooftops and a tall chimney emerge faintly through the haze beyond. Pissarro keeps the whole palette muted and cold, snow and sky nearly the same soft gray-white.
items.tags: snow, winter, orchard, pissarro, éragny, landscape, impressionism
items.credit_line: Musée des Beaux-Arts de Dijon, 28 September 2019

items.title: Jardin des Tuileries, Effect of Snow
items.description_narrative: A blanket of snow covers a formal garden's paths and round fountain basin, bare trees casting thin shadows across the white ground. An ornate stone building with a flag rises hazily on the left, its details softened by winter light. Muted grays and pale blues give the whole scene a still, wintry hush.
items.tags: snow, winter, garden, formal garden, impressionism, cityscape, fountain

items.title: Washerwoman, Study
items.description_narrative: A woman in a striped blouse and yellow headscarf sits with her arms crossed, gazing off to the side against a plain green wall. Warm light catches her weathered face and the folds of her scarf, rendered in loose, confident brushwork.
items.tags: portrait study, pissarro, figure study, washerwoman

items.title: A Washerwoman at Éragny
items.description_narrative: A woman in a pale headscarf and long apron bends over a wooden washtub, scrubbing linen amid a lush garden of trees and flowering shrubs. Sunlight breaks through the foliage in small, vibrating dabs of color, with a red rooftop just visible at the upper right.
items.tags: washerwoman, pissarro, garden, rural labor, pointillism

items.title: The Haymaker
items.description_narrative: A woman in a plain dress and straw hat rests one hand on the long handle of a rake, pausing amid a field of tall grass. A fenced pasture with grazing cattle and a small child stretch out behind her. Loose, textured brushwork builds the greenery into a dense, sun-warmed tangle.
items.tags: haymaker, rural labor, field, figure study, peasant, impressionism, pasture

items.title: Sunset at Éragny
items.description_narrative: A glowing sun sinks low over a row of dark, wind-bent trees, its light spreading across the sky in bands of pink, lavender, and gold. Below, a stretch of yellow-green field runs flat to the tree line, the scene built from short, vibrating strokes of color.
items.tags: sunset, pissarro, landscape, eragny, evening light
items.credit_line: Google Arts & Culture: Home page – Image

items.title: Gardener Standing by a Haystack, Overcast Sky, Éragny
items.description_narrative: A man in a broad straw hat and blue overalls stands beside a mound of golden hay, gazing across a field bordered by tall flowering weeds. Behind him another figure bends low, gathering the harvest, while slim trees frame a pale, overcast sky. The muted light flattens color into soft yellows and greens.
items.tags: haystack, gardener, harvest, overcast sky, rural labor, impressionism, field

items.title: Portrait of Eugène Murer
items.description_narrative: Set in an oval format, this portrait shows a bearded man wrapped in a bright red patterned scarf, his dark jacket dissolving into a softly blurred ground.
items.tags: portrait, oval format, scarf, beard, impressionism
items.current_repository: Michele & Donald D'Amour Museum of Fine Arts

items.title: Farm at Montfoucault
items.description_narrative: A woman bends over a flock of poultry gathered near a cluster of stone farm buildings, tucked into a wooded hollow thick with autumn-toned trees. Sunlight filters down through gaps in the canopy, dappling the rooftops and the path below in patches of gold. Pissarro paints the farm as a small clearing carved out of the surrounding woods, buildings and greenery pressed close together.
items.tags: farm, poultry, montfoucault, pissarro, impressionism, rural life, woodland
items.current_repository: Museum of Art and History Geneva

items.title: Garden and Chicken Coop of Octave Mirbeau, Les Damps
items.description_narrative: A path of bare earth and grass winds between dense borders of red, orange, and yellow dahlias, flanked by tall conifers and flowering shrubs. A red-roofed building is just visible through the foliage at the end of the path, a small note of structure in an otherwise overgrown, blooming garden. Pissarro paints the whole scene in short, dense strokes, packing the canvas with color from edge to edge.
items.tags: garden, dahlias, pissarro, flowers, impressionism, les damps, foliage

items.title: Haymaking
items.description_narrative: A line of women in bonnets and long skirts bends together across a hillside field, rendered in pale washes of green, blue, and rust. Rolling hills and a scattering of trees fade into the paper's white beyond them. The sketch-like looseness of the watercolor keeps the figures almost translucent.
items.tags: haymaking, watercolor, sketch, rural labor, field, impressionism, figures

items.title: The Siesta, Éragny
items.description_narrative: A woman in a pale dress and pink headscarf lies curled against a haystack, resting in the shade of fruit trees. A basket sits nearby, and red-tiled rooftops rise beyond the orchard under a soft midday sky.
items.tags: siesta, haystack, orchard, pissarro, rural life, rest

items.title: Garden in Full Sunlight, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: Sunlight breaks through billowing white clouds onto a walled garden, where red-tiled rooftops and a stone chimney rise above a screen of trees. A lone dark-clad figure pauses beside a stone pillar on the garden path, dwarfed by the surrounding foliage. Thick, loose strokes of warm and cool green let the sky's brightness spill across the lawn.
items.tags: garden, sunlight, clouds, rooftops, impressionism, landscape, figure

items.title: Peasants in the Fields, Éragny
items.description_narrative: A woman carries a woven basket on her hip while a man beside her rests a hoe on his shoulder, both pausing in a furrowed field; further off, a horse team works another row, and a child crouches alone at the field's edge.
items.tags: peasant, fieldwork, horse, rural, impressionism

items.title: Autumn, Poplars, Éragny
items.description_narrative: Tall, slender poplars rise above a tangle of golden and rust-colored underbrush, their bare upper branches reaching into a pale, cloud-streaked sky. A young sapling stands alone on the mown grass in the foreground. Camille Pissarro painted these poplars in 1894.
items.tags: poplars, autumn, trees, landscape, impressionism, oil painting
items.credit_line: FAGSHZBzEXp4JQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Gardener, Old Peasant with Cabbage
items.description_narrative: An old gardener in a flat cap and apron cradles a large, leafy cabbage in both arms, his weathered face bent in concentration. Behind him a row of round cabbage heads fills the patch, rendered in loose dabs of gray-green. The close, informal view turns ordinary field work into quiet portraiture.
items.tags: gardener, cabbage, peasant, portrait, rural labor, impressionism, vegetable garden

items.title: The Bather
items.description_narrative: A young woman stands nude beneath an overhanging tree at the water's edge, a pale cloth gathered loosely at her waist as she glances downward. Small dabbed strokes render the still river and wooded far bank behind her. Camille Pissarro painted this bather in 1895.
items.tags: bather, nude, riverbank, tree, impressionism, oil painting

items.title: The Children
items.description_narrative: Two children sit together at a kitchen table, the older girl's long hair falling loose as she watches her younger sibling read from a folded paper. A pitcher and a tall green bottle stand behind them on the table's edge, morning light coming in through a window at the left. Pissarro renders the domestic scene in soft crosshatched strokes of blue-green and pink gouache.
items.tags: children, domestic scene, gouache, pissarro, interior, siblings, impressionism
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the National Gallery of Art. Please see the Gallery's Open Access Policy.
items.current_repository: drawings in the National Gallery of Art

items.title: Peasant Girl with a Straw Hat
items.description_narrative: A wide straw hat, tied with a thin red ribbon, shades a young peasant girl's face as she sits with her hands folded in her lap, greenery dissolving into soft brushstrokes behind her.
items.tags: peasant, portrait, straw hat, rural, impressionism
items.credit_line: National Gallery of Art – The Collection – Peasant Girl with a Straw Hat

items.title: Path in a Forest
items.description_narrative: Sunlight barely reaches the forest floor here, filtering down through a dense canopy onto a narrow dirt path. A small seated figure rests at the base of a pale birch trunk, dwarfed by the surrounding dark.
items.tags: forest, path, early work, landscape, dark
items.credit_line: Sotheby's Hong Kong, 22 June 2012, Corot to Monet – French Landscape Painting in the Nineteenth and Twentieth Centuries, lot 2

items.title: The Artist's Garden at Éragny
items.description_narrative: A woman bends low among vegetable rows in the foreground while tall flowers and shrubbery, including sunflowers, screen a gabled house beyond. Loose bundles of cut branches lie stacked to one side. Camille Pissarro painted this garden scene in 1898.
items.tags: garden, flowers, sunflowers, woman gardening, house, oil painting
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the National Gallery of Art. Please see the Gallery's Open Access Policy.

items.title: Bridge at Caracas
items.description_narrative: A single palm tree leans over a stone bridge arcing across a rocky ravine, hills fading into the pale, sun-bleached distance. Tiny figures in dark clothing cross the span and gather on the path below, sketched in with just a few quick strokes of the brush. Pissarro works in watercolor here, the paper's cream tone standing in for the sky.
items.tags: watercolor, bridge, ravine, palm tree, figures, pissarro, landscape sketch
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the National Gallery of Art. Please see the Gallery's Open Access Policy.
items.current_repository: drawings in the National Gallery of Art

items.title: The Goose Girl at Montfoucault, White Frost
items.description_narrative: A girl in a white cap leans against a wooden fence rail while geese file past her along a pale, frost-whitened path. Overhead, a gnarled, half-bare tree stands amid a screen of golden autumn foliage. Cool blue shadows and warm yellow leaves play off each other across the canvas.
items.tags: geese, goose girl, autumn, rural life, farmyard, impressionism, landscape
items.credit_line: 1. Google Cultural Institute2. Museum of Fine Arts, Houston, online collection

items.title: A Creek in St. Thomas, Virgin Islands
items.description_narrative: Tall palm trees lean over a quiet tidal creek, their fronds catching the last warm light of a pink-tinged sunset. A lone figure with a long pole stands at the water's edge while faint silhouettes of others linger further down the bank, hazy cliffs across the water fading into the dusk. Pissarro paints the whole scene in soft, sun-bleached tones, the water barely rippled beneath the stillness of the evening.
items.tags: st thomas, virgin islands, tropical, palm trees, pissarro, landscape, sunset

items.title: Landscape with Houses and Enclosure Wall, Frost and Mist, Éragny
items.description_narrative: Frost coats a stand of bare, spindly trees and shrubs behind a low garden wall, with a chimneyed rooftop at left and a warm, rust-colored house at right. Thin, leafless branches reach up through the foreground mist in soft, broken strokes of white and grey-green. Pissarro painted the frosty garden in 1892.
items.tags: landscape, eragny, pissarro, frost, winter, impressionism
items.credit_line: Sotheby's Beijing, 22 June 2012, Corot to Monet – French Landscape Painting in the Nineteenth and Twentieth Centuries, lot 17

items.title: Sunset, the Port of Rouen, Steamboats
items.description_narrative: Steamboats send plumes of smoke drifting into a glowing sunset sky, the sun's reflection scattering in gold across the harbor water. Small figures move along the quay in the foreground, dwarfed by the masts, smokestacks, and distant rooftops.
items.tags: port, steamboats, pissarro, sunset, industrial, rouen

items.title: Kew Green
items.description_narrative: Tall factory chimneys rise behind a row of trees and red-roofed houses, while dozens of tiny figures dot a wide green, some seemingly mid-game. Broken, dappled brushstrokes blur the crowd into flickers of color under a hazy, warm sky. Pissarro painted the scene in 1892.
items.tags: landscape, village green, pissarro, impressionism, figures, chimneys, dappled light

items.title: The Fence
items.description_narrative: A gnarled, leafless tree twists up at the left, its bare branches spreading wide against a pale winter sky. Below, a man and woman lean together at a low wooden fence enclosing a kitchen garden, talking quietly while a third figure walks away down the path. Village rooftops and more trees fill the middle distance, the whole scene rendered in soft, wintry grays and browns.
items.tags: winter, garden fence, pissarro, village, impressionism, bare tree, figures

items.title: L'Hermitage in Summer, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: From a hilltop, red-roofed houses cluster among dense trees in a valley that stretches toward a hazy town on the horizon. Rolling green fields fill the foreground beneath a wide sky piled with soft white clouds. Pissarro painted this view over Pontoise in 1877.
items.tags: landscape, pontoise, pissarro, hilltop view, village, impressionism
items.credit_line: Sotheby's New York, 03 May 2011, N08741 lot 36

items.title: The Hills of Le Chou, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: Wildflowers speckle a grassy hillside that slopes down toward a cluster of red-roofed houses tucked among trees. A path curves off to the right, past more houses toward open fields. Loose, sunlit brushwork captures the slope's texture in yellow-green and rust tones.
items.tags: hillside, wildflowers, village, landscape, impressionism, countryside, path

items.title: View of Bazincourt, Snow, Sunset
items.description_narrative: A hazy winter sun glows low over a snow-covered river, its pale light catching a row of bare poplars along the near bank. Distant rooftops and a church spire emerge faintly from the trees on the far shore, the scene wrapped in cold pink and lavender light.
items.tags: snow, sunset, pissarro, river, winter, bazincourt

items.title: Peasant Women Planting Poles
items.description_narrative: Four peasant women raise long poles together in a single upward gesture, their striped and patterned skirts built from small, separate dabs of color.
items.tags: peasant, labor, pointillism, rural, impressionism

items.title: La Sente de Justice, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A dirt path skirts a young orchard planted on a bare, ochre hillside, with two women in red-trimmed dresses walking away along a wooden fence. Below, a cluster of rooftops and a slender church spire emerge through the trees, with smoke rising from a distant chimney. Pissarro painted the scene in 1872.
items.tags: landscape, pontoise, pissarro, orchard, hillside, impressionism, village view

items.title: Ruelle des Poulies, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A dirt path winds past stone cottages and a small flag-topped outbuilding on a hillside, a church tower rising in the distance. Scrubby grass and bare trees fill the foreground beneath a wide, cloud-streaked sky.
items.tags: landscape, village, pissarro, hillside, pontoise

items.title: The Dunes at Knokke, Effect of Sunlight
items.description_narrative: Rolling green dunes stretch toward a cluster of red-roofed houses tucked among trees in the distance, a wide, cloud-filled sky pressing down over the whole scene. Pissarro builds the grassy slopes from short, choppy strokes of green, gold, and violet, catching the play of sunlight across the uneven ground. Not a single figure appears; the dunes and clouds alone carry the whole composition.
items.tags: dunes, knokke, belgium, landscape, pissarro, impressionism, coastal

items.title: Louveciennes with Mont Valérien in the Background
items.description_narrative: A pale stone house crowns a grassy hilltop overlooking a red-roofed village, where three figures pause near a bare, solitary tree. Distant hills rise hazy blue beyond the rooftops under a softly clouded sky. Pissarro painted the view in 1870.
items.tags: landscape, pissarro, louveciennes, village view, impressionism, figures

items.title: The Road, Louveciennes, Effect of Snow
items.description_narrative: Two bundled figures make their way down a snow-covered lane between bare trees and a row of snow-capped houses, a horse and rider pausing near the buildings on the right. Pale blue sky and long shadows give the cold, bright day a crisp stillness.
items.tags: snow, winter, village, pissarro, horse, landscape

items.title: Route de Versailles, Louveciennes
items.description_narrative: A solitary woman in a dark cloak walks along a snow-covered road, one bare tree rising beside her as rows of houses fade into misty distance. To the right, a rider on horseback pauses outside a two-story house capped with snow.
items.tags: snow, winter, road, woman, sisley, muted palette

items.title: Charing Cross Bridge, London
items.description_narrative: A long iron bridge stretches across a pale, silvery river toward a hazy skyline of towers and spires, small boats and a flower-laden barge dotting the water in the foreground. Broad clouds fill most of the canvas, their soft grays and creams echoed in the river below. The view looks toward Westminster on the River Thames, painted with the short, even brushstrokes Pissarro favored for his London scenes.
items.tags: london, thames, westminster, bridge, pissarro, cityscape, impressionism

items.title: Banks of the Oise at Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A tall factory chimney releases a plume of dark smoke above a riverside town, its rooftops and a church spire clustered beneath scattered clouds. Along the towpath, a man in a top hat and a woman with a parasol stroll past a row of tall trees. Camille Pissarro painted this view of the Oise in 1867.
items.tags: river, chimney, industry, towpath, landscape, oil painting

items.title: Banks of the Oise, the Countryside near Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A masted barge drifts on a wide green river, two figures standing near its cabin, while a willow leans thick and shaggy over the near bank. Rooftops of a small riverside village cluster along the far shore beneath a cloud-streaked sky. Camille Pissarro painted this view in 1877.
items.tags: river, barge, willow, village, landscape, oil painting

items.title: Pontoise, Banks of the Oise
items.description_narrative: A row of tall trees lines the near riverbank, their trunks nearly black against the light, while rooftops cluster on the far shore beneath a sky full of piled cloud. A boat sits moored at the water's edge, small figures gathered nearby.
items.tags: river, trees, clouds, boats, landscape, impressionism

items.title: Waterside at Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A row of tall poplars lines the near bank of a river, their reflections rippling in the still water below. Across the water, a factory chimney sends smoke into a cloud-filled sky, with a cluster of houses visible beneath the drifting haze.
items.tags: river, pissarro, poplars, pontoise, industry, landscape

items.title: Montfoucault Pond, Winter Effect
items.description_narrative: Bare trees crook sharply over a still, ice-grey pond, and a small figure tends grazing cattle at the water's edge in flat winter light.
items.tags: pond, winter, landscape, cattle, impressionism

items.title: Montfoucault Pond
items.description_narrative: A small flock of ducks paddles across a still pond, ripples fanning out behind them, while a white birch trunk leans low over the water's edge.
items.tags: pond, ducks, autumn, landscape, impressionism

items.title: A Street in L'Hermitage, Pontoise
items.description_narrative: A dirt street winds between a walled garden and rows of houses with red-tiled roofs, two women and a small dog pausing near a gateway. Further along, a horse and cart pass beneath tall trees under a bright, cloud-streaked sky.
items.tags: street scene, village, pissarro, figures, pontoise

items.title: Piette's House at Montfoucault, Effect of Snow
items.description_narrative: Bare, frost-blue trees nearly swallow a snow-dusted farmhouse, its chimney and walls just visible beneath a flat grey sky.
items.tags: farmhouse, snow, winter, landscape, impressionism

items.title: Piette's House at Montfoucault
items.description_narrative: A farmhouse chimney rises above a screen of summer trees, two figures standing on the lawn below while a scatter of dark birds picks at the grass.

items.title: Boulevard des Capucines (Nelson-Atkins version)
items.description_narrative: Seen from a high balcony, the boulevard dissolves into a blur of black-coated pedestrians, bare winter trees, and pale stone façades stretching into the distance. Monet paints the crowd as flickers of dark paint rather than individual people, capturing the sensation of a busy street glimpsed from above rather than any one face in it. This is the Boulevard des Capucines, now held by the Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art.
items.tags: paris, boulevard des capucines, cityscape, crowd, impressionism, monet, aerial view
